programme.title: Andromeda: Vægten (del 1)
programme.desc: Dylan ender på Seefra, hvor den overtroiske befolkning ikke har nogen teknologi.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vægten (del 2)
programme.desc: Beka bliver dumpet på Seefra, efter at Andromeda er blevet stjålet, og Dylan skal bevise, at skibet er hans.

programme.title: Andromeda: Phear Phactor Phenom
programme.desc: På Seefra finder Dylan dog Harper, som har tilpasset sig til livet der.

programme.title: Andromeda: Englens forfald
programme.desc: Det viser sig, at Doyle er en android, som Harper har bygget til at indeholde Rommies kerneprogrammering.

programme.title: Andromeda: Eskatologien i vores nutid
programme.desc: Beka vinder en pris fra en radio-DJ, lærer sandheden om Seefra og finder Meethus-diagrammet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Når det går rundt...
programme.desc: En videnskabsmand fra det oprindelige Commonwealth dukker op og er fanget i en tidsløjfe.

programme.title: Andromeda: Forsøg på afretningslag
programme.desc: Flavin vender tilbage, hvilket udløser en bandekrig, og hjælper Dylan med at udvikle sig som Paradine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Så brænder de utæmmede lande
programme.desc: En krystal, der kan genoprette Andromedas kraft, bliver fundet, men for at få fat i den må Dylan arbejde for minens ejer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvad der vil ske, var ikke
programme.desc: Der er opdaget tunneller på Seefra, som kan bruges til at nå otte andre Seefra-planeter.
programme.sub-title: Hvad der vil ske, var ikke

programme.title: Andromeda: Prøven
programme.desc: Da en gammel mand bliver dræbt, er Beka, Rhade og Harper de hovedmistænkte og skal for retten.

programme.title: Andromeda: Gennem et mørkt glas
programme.desc: Rhade leder oprørerne i en kamp mod en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stolthed før faldet
programme.desc: Dylan finder ud af, at Bekas kæreste var Drago Musevini, og at han brugte Bekas DNA til at skabe nietzscheanerne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Måneskin bliver til dig
programme.desc: Beka og Rhade finder en prøve, der enten vil give dem stor rigdom eller drive dem til vanvid.

programme.title: Andromeda: Fortiden er uendelig
programme.desc: Harper opdager et program, der kan ødelægge otte af Seefra-planeterne og dræbe millioner af mennesker.

programme.title: Andromeda: Modsætningerne af tiltrækning
programme.desc: Mens Harper arbejder på en måde at redde Seefra-systemet på, sniger en spion sig om bord på Andromeda og angriber Beka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Saving Light From a Black Sun
programme.desc: Der gøres et forsøg på at reparere Seefras blinkende sol, men Trance erstattes af en dobbeltgænger.
programme.sub-title: Saving Light From a Black Sun

programme.title: Andromeda: Samlet tilbagekaldelse
programme.desc: Da Dylan bliver alvorligt såret i en laboratorieeksplosion, rejser han gennem en række alternative virkeligheder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Quantum Tractate Delirium
programme.desc: Rommie bliver genopbygget for at hjælpe med at evakuere Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endnu en dags lys
programme.desc: En krigsherre overbeviser sine tilhængere om, at den forestående ødelæggelse af de ydre planeter er et komplot, der skal gøre det lettere for dem at plyndre deres planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kaos og stilheden i det
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade og Beka arbejder sammen for at redde Trance fra Methus-2 og Harper fra general Burma.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Driven to Silence
programme.desc: A young hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon. The evidence at the crime scene didn't match any of the suspects and, after the initial investigation, the case went cold for ten years.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: In 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen received threatening emails and then disappeared. Tracking the source of the emails led police to the home of Daphne Wright, where they believe a murder was committed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purebread Murder
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids apartment after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Formula
programme.desc: When four-month-old Ryan Stallings dies under suspicious circumstances, his mother is ultimately convicted of his murder. But months later, new evidence emerges from a startling source — his newborn brother.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Photo Finish
programme.desc: Professional photographer Charles Rathbun claims model Linda Sobek died during a consensual sexual encounter gone wrong, but Sobek's corpse and digital imaging tell a more sinister story.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence
programme.desc: After a street fight takes the life of a national wrestling champion, police must determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Paintball
programme.desc: In 1962, the small town residents of Hanford, California lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home of the Brave
programme.desc: In 2007, the Florida mobile home of Effie and Michael Ratley catches fire. Michael heroically rescues his wife and infant son. A month later, his wife is found beaten to death in a bedroom of his parents' home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg to Stand On
programme.desc: The police investigate when a severed leg is discovered among garbage. Conventional means of identifying the victim are impossible, leading investigators to rely on DNA, forensic anthropology and toxicology.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, a Maryland murder mystery performance turns into a real whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Slippery Motives
programme.desc: Edward Post drew a bath for his wife before going for a run. He returned to find her not breathing. She died before emergency response arrived. Police considered her death accidental until a motive surfaced.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Low Maintenance
programme.desc: In 2008, college co-ed Jenna Verhaalen was found dead in her Bryan, Texas apartment. Petechial hemorrhages in her eyes indicated that she was strangled.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Dangerq
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Speck of Evidence
programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a bank teller arrived at her parent's home the gunmen were already there. The robbers held her family hostage and forced her to empty a bank vault. If she didn't comply she could lose everyone she loved.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1990s, one criminal terrorized an entire community. Witnesses refused to speak out. They knew the consequences could be deadly.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Louisiana, a brutal killer turned a rural area into his personal hunting ground. He preyed on the defenseless, the weak and the elderly.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal. When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted. The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Murder-for-hire is a complex crime. Solving it means finding the killer, and whoever paid for the hit. In South Carolina a death first ruled accidental was no accident, but that was just the beginning.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, a gang of robbers target an ATM repository and hit the jackpot. Their take was over a million dollars in cash, the largest heist in Las Vegas history.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
programme.desc: Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1992, a woman disappeared from her Memphis home. When the ransom went uncollected, the FBI suspected a desperate amateur and feared the worst.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Etna, New Hampshire is a small town. It's the kind of place where people trust their neighbors and leave their doors unlocked. A double murder shattered that trust and left the entire community terrified.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: IFISH: Mulloway - Botany Bay, NSW
programme.desc: Ever wondered why Captain Cook chose to first land on the southern banks of Botany Bay on Sunday 29th April 1770? Because the fishing is so hot! The fish were coming in so thick and fast the boys had to take a break...

programme.title: Anglers Digest: St. Lucia

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Curaçao

programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training

programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.desc: Gammel kærlighed blusser op da Stephen Coletti dukker op i Laurens liv igen. Heidi prøver at sørge for, at Stephanie ikke kommer til Laurens housewarming.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren har svært ved at vælge side, da problemerne mellem Lo og Audrina eskalerer. Og Heidi tager et job, der vil tage hende til Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit føler Audrina sig lukket ude af Laurens venskab med Lo, og hun overvejer at flytte ud. Lauren gør et sidste forsøg på at blive god venner med Audrina, men måske er det for sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: Da sæson fire starter er situationen mellem Audrina og Lo anspændt. Lauren forsøger at gøre et godt indtryk på en ny fyr, og et besøg fra Heidis søster Holly truer Spencer og Heidis forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie bliver uvenner med sin bror og hans ven da Lauren møder Spencer på sin fødselsdag. Kelly Cutrone fyrer en fra People's Revolution og Whitney overtager stillingen. Laurens forhold til Doug udvikler sig lidt for hurtigt.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren indser at den kemi, hun havde med Doug på studiet ikke længere er der. Whitney er nervøs for at tage til New York, men en date med en model gør hende gladere. Til trods for forsoningsgestusen vil Spencer bryde helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En vild tur til Las Vegas går galt, da Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody nævner Stephanies fortid, og drengene ryger i brummen. Heidis søster Holly flytter ind, men det er intet Spencer hellere vil end at smide hende ud.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sandheden om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer frem, da de alle mødes til Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøg til LA og ryger ud i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi, hvor hun beklager og indser, at der kun er én ting, som forhindrer dem i at blive venner igen. Audrina starter med at date en ny fyr for at gøre Justin jaloux, men hendes plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møder sin gamle flamme Corey igen og jonglerer pludselig to fyre. Spencer tvinger Heidi til at smide sin søster Holly ud af lejligheden.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina rejser til Cabo til Brody fødselsdag, men da Justin bliver jaloux på Audrinas nye forhold, udvikler festen sig til en slåskamp. Spencer ydmyger Stephanie da hun finder ud af, at hendes nye kæreste er ven med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at skabe fred mellem Brody og Stephanie. Audrina vil få tingene til at fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke give slip på hende. Stephanie tvivler på sin nye kæreste, da han bryder sit løfte om at konfrontere Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sit eget sted, og håber, at Justin vil flytte ind hos hende, men alle frygter, at hun flytter af den forkerte grund. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med arbejdet og bliver taget i at have det lidt for sjovt.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney tager til New York i forventning om at møde Alex igen, men en ny fyr ved navn Jay fanger hendes opmærksomhed. Heidi er ulykkelig efter fyringen, men da Spencer taler med Brent for at skaffe hende jobbet tilbage, forværrer han situationen.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lader Heidis søster overnatte. Justin inviterer Audrina med på en romantisk weekend, og Heidis frustration med Spencer vokser, da hun må tigge for at få sit job tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rygte, hun hører: at Lauren har kysset med Justin. I mellemtiden prøver Holly at få Heidi væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøger at redde sit venskab med Lauren efter at have anklaget hende for at have kysset med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøger deres bedstemore, som er træt af, at de skændes.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney bliver tilbudt en chance for a score sit drømmejob NYC og håber at se Jay der. Lauren bliver nostalgisk, da hendes forældre sælger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie går til Spencer for at få hjælp med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer deres bekymrede familier og stikker af til Mexico for at blive gift. Whitney går efter drømmejobbet i New York City, og siger farvel til Lauren og sit liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi mødes og husker, hvorfor de plejede at være venner. Spencer og Heidi er lige blevet gift, da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin chokerer Audrina, da han tager hende med til Palm Springs til en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Da Heidi kommer uanmeldt til Laurens fødselsdagsfest, græder de to gamle venner over deres ødelagte venskab. Spencer kommer op at slås, da Cameron beskylder ham for at samle en bartender op.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flirtende opførsel får Heidi til at tage hjem til Colorado, hvor hun møder en gammel kæreste. Lauren skælder Stephanie ud for at have inviteret Heidi til festen. Spencer ender en lang stilhed med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Da Heidi overrasker Spencer på en natklub med bartenderen Stacie, forlanger hun, at de går i parterapi. Lauren risikerer sit rygte, da hun skaffer Stephanie en praktikplads hos People's Revolution.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at komme sig over Justin ved at gå efter Brody. Heidi slæber en modvillig Spencer med til parterapi. Da Stephanie kvajer sig hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med at fyre hende.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at glemme Justin ved at score Brody, da pigerne tager med på drengenes surf-tur til Hawaii. Heidis uskyldige ekskæreste kommer på besøg, og hun håber, at hans værdier vil smitte af på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: The Bird Has Landed

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: SOS, Save Our Singles

programme.title: Are You The One?: Punch Drunk Love
programme.desc: John eksploderer, når forholdet til Julia forandrer sig. Asaf og Francesca ved ikke, hvor de står, da en tur til bolleværelset kikser. Kaylen slipper en bombe om sit forhold til Gio, som chokerer huset.

programme.desc: Fyrene viser deres bløde siger, når deres mødre afslører pinlige detaljer. Stephen bliver ekstremt paranoid på grund af Gios intresse for Julia. Francesca bliver fanget i Gios klør.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Great Ex-pectations

programme.title: Are You The One?: All or Nothing
programme.desc: Det er alt eller intet, da den tiende og sidste parceremoni nærmer sig. Strategien fører gruppen til at tro på visse par, men Asaf er splittet mellem at følge sit hjerte eller sit team.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Swipe Right for Love

programme.title: Are You The One?: Bae-trayl

programme.title: Are You The One?: Don't Come at Me Crazy

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tra Cray

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players

programme.title: Are You The One?: No Love in Nola

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Bare Juliet
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er kørt træt i sit parforhold med Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), der er kæmpefan af musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Da en demoversion af Tuckers gamle hit LP dukker op, bliver det starten på et nyt møde med den flyvske kunstner.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: Fra John Travoltas fængslende og Oscarnominerede præstation til Bee Gees succes-soundtrack og de uforglemmelige dansetrin - "Saturday Night Fever" er en filmsensation, der fangede verdens opmærksomhed som aldrig før.

programme.title: The Perfect Host
programme.desc: Warwick Wilson er en omsorgsfuld vært. Han forbereder omhyggeligt en middag, bordet er perfekt dækket og maden er klar præcis kl halv ni. John Taylor er en vaneforbryder, som lige har røvet en bank og har brug for at gå under jorden.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: På Westberg High School regerer tre populære skønhedsdronninger, der alle hedder Heather til fornavn. Veronica hader de tre Heather-piger, og går sammen med den rebelske Jason Dean for at få hævn over de tre piger.

programme.title: Under træet
programme.desc: Agnes smider Atli ud hjemmefra og nægter ham at se deres datter Ása. Atli må flytte hjem til sine forældre, der selv er i problemer i en bitter nabostrid omkring deres store smukke træ, der kaster en skygge på naboens terrasse.

programme.title: Mother & Child
programme.desc: Karen bortadopterede en lille pige, da hun var 14 år gammel, men selv om hun aldrig har mødt hende, fylder datteren meget i Karens tanker. Advokaten Elizabeth er adoptivbarn og har fuld gang i karrieren, men i sit privatliv er hun ensom.

programme.title: The Cider House Rules
programme.desc: Den Oscar®-vindende publikumsfavorit om en mand, der søger efter et tilhørssted. Filmatiseret af bestsellerromanen, John Irvings stærke lektion om livet, kærlighed og hjemmet fik ros af kritikere og biografgæster over alt.

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: I denne spændende sci-fi -thriller havner en gruppeunge amerikanere midt i en desperat kamp foroverlevelse, da de står over for en apokalyptiskrumvæsen-invasion i Moskva.

programme.title: Big Kill
programme.desc: Jim Andrews tager til byen Big Kill for at slutte sig til sin bror. Undervejs møder han to mænd eftersøgt af den mexicanske hær og hyrer dem til at vejlede og beskytte ham. Når de først er der, står de ansigt til ansigt med en truende prædikant.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Daniel Radcliffe kæmper mod naturens brutale kræfter og sit eget sind, da han forsøger at overleve i Bolivias nådesløse jungle.

programme.title: Lionheart
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme spiller Lyon Gaultier, som deserterer fra den franske Fremmedlegion for at hjælpe sin myrdede brors familie i USA. Men at komme gennem USA uden penge på lommen viser sig at være svært.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Næsten 20 år efter, at TV-kultserien Galaxy Quest blev stoppet, beder en race af rumvæsner holdet fra serien om hjælp til at redde universet.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Efter Cady har boet i Afrika, aner hun intet om, hvor 'vilde' ting kan blive i civilisationen, indtil hun møder den ondeste art 'Queen Bee', der på denne skole er den kølige og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad har en udmærket karriere og lever et komfortabelt liv sammen med sin hustru og søn, men hans gamle venners liv virker mere glamourøst og rigt. Da han genoptager kontakten med dem, kommer han dog til at tvivle på, hvem der lever det gode liv.

programme.title: The Giant Mechanical Man
programme.desc: To ensomme sjæle finder kærlighed og en forbindelse midt i storbyens kaos. En hjertevarm fortælling om kunst, skæve eksistenser og humor.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Tre mænd genoplever deres sorgløse collegetid ved at dræbe så mange hjerneceller, de kan, i denne forskruede komedie. Mitch kommer hjem fra en mindre behagelig forretningsrejse og afslører sin kone Heidi midt i en trekant.

programme.title: Waiting . . .
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris og Justin Long serverer grinene som unge tjenere og servitricer, der søger en mening med livet, kærligheden og venskabet i denne forrygende komedie.

programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: Woody Allen er tilbage i formidabel form med en vittig og begavet storbykomedie om to generationers passioner, kriser og fortumlede forsøg på at finde lykken.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: En komedie om en stuntmann som aldri har greid å lande uten å besvime og om forsøket på å mestre sitt livs største stunt.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: En rig families "sorte får" møder en ung psykiatrisk patient, der er vokset op isoleret hele sit liv. Han tager den naive unge kvinde med hjem til sin brors bryllup.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Will erfarer, at hans kæreste Amy har en affære med undertøjsmodellen Flavor. Da Will efterfølgende holder en fest kommer Amy med sin nye flamme. Pludselig begynder alt at ryste. Det viser sig, at jorden på samme tid rammes af alle naturkatastrofer.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en rigtig filmnørd, som ejer en lille videobutik. Når han ikke sidder fastklistret foran fjernsynet og en eller anden film noir, diskuterer han film med sine to medarbejdere, supernørden Lucien og den noget stabilere Jonathan.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Episode 13
programme.desc: A consummate con artist is finally trapped in an elaborate sting. Can a skilled forensic psychologist prevent her from succeeding in a final, clever deception?

programme.title: Exhibit A: House Hermit
programme.desc: After breaking into a series of cottages, a mysterious house hermit turns killer. The case is unlocked when the police turn to the public for help and release the killer’s distinctive handwriting to the press.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Killer in a Box
programme.desc: In 1986, Toronto and the rest of Canada were stunned by the Alison Parrott case. More than a decade would pass before this tragic case would be solved thanks to the perseverance of the newly formed “Cold Case Squad.”

programme.title: Exhibit A: Sky High
programme.desc: A quiet May evening is shattered by the blast of a huge explosion and minutes later part of a quiet urban neighbourhood is up in flames. The police are confronted with hate slogans spray-painted onto what is left of a garage door.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Suspicion
programme.desc: An Ottawa journalist champions early parole for a convicted murderer and in the tradition of a cheap romance novel, ends up falling in love with him. After he’s released, the two move in together. Then she mysteriously disappears.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Fabric of Lies
programme.desc: A three and a half-year-old child is reported missing. After a 20-day search, her body is found floating in Toronto harbour. Fibre evidence found throughout the child’s clothes plays a crucial role in solving this crime and convicting a child killer.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Tragedy of Errors
programme.desc: “Tragedy of Errors” focuses on the forensic skills of two blood spattering experts. As the story unfolds we witness how these investigators are able to decipher a story from bloodstain patterns the way archaeologists read ancient hieroglyphics

programme.title: Exhibit A: Killer Gloves
programme.desc: An intruder breaks into a family home in a well-to-do Calgary neighbourhood. When he’s confronted by the owner, the burglar stabs him to death. The killer flees leaving behind several smudged prints on a window that appear to be left by a pair of gloves.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Dead Sea
programme.desc: A fisherman, trawling off the English coast, comes upon what appears to be a large fish in his net. But it turns out to be a dead body. The body is wearing shoes and a Rolex watch, but has no I.D. – is it murder or suicide?

programme.title: Exhibit A: The Trouble With Susan
programme.desc: A woman is reported missing. It takes nearly 2 weeks for the police to determine that this is no missing person case. The homicide squad slowly amasses enough evidence to charge a man with murder even though the victim’s body still has not been found.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Stopwatch Gang
programme.desc: In 1974, this band of gentlemanly bank robbers from Canada stole $700,000 in gold bricks from a storage warehouse at Ottawa International Airport. It was and still is Canada’s biggest-ever gold robbery.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Stalked
programme.desc: Two young sisters are murdered and recovered DNA points a “finger from the grave” at the killer. The police determine the crime scene had been staged to look like a ‘break and enter’ and the primary motive for the crime was homicide not theft.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: In this case, a forensic scientist misinterprets the facts surrounding a shooting, thereby allowing the guilty party to walk free. But the victim’s mother won’t let the case rest. Eventually she gathers enough evidence to reopen the case

programme.title: Exhibit A: Out of Control
programme.desc: A finger print from a piece of broken glass sets in motion what becomes an investigation spanning 2 provinces and involving numerous police forces and social agencies. A deranged murderer is on the loose, and needs to be stopped before he kills again.

programme.title: Exhibit A
programme.desc: A serial rapist in Lafayette, Louisiana is finally caught thanks to a local investigator and a Canadian forensic scientist, who developed “geographic profiling.” This analytical tool helps investigators figure out where a serial criminal lives.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Time Bomb
programme.desc: A bomb goes off in a postal truck in downtown Toronto. A security camera records the reaction of the burning postal driver. His trauma is so severe, he is put in an induced coma. Who set the bomb? Who was the target?

programme.title: Exhibit A: North Bay
programme.desc: An exhaustive 18-month investigation follows the murder of a young woman in North Bay. The prime suspect’s DNA matches that on the woman’s clothes. In a startling development, further DNA tests prove the wrong man has been charged.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Accident
programme.desc: A car carrying six friends crashes. As bodies fly in all directions, four teenagers die and two are critically injured. Sara LeBeau, who owns the car, survives but has total amnesia. Who was driving?

programme.title: Exhibit A: Beauty Shop Bandit
programme.desc: In 1990, John Willis of Chicago is sentenced to 105 years in prison for a series of bizarre robberies and sexual assaults. They all take place in women’s beauty shops. Willis proclaims his innocence.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Turnbull
programme.desc: She was a typical teenager. In 15 minutes she went from living an ordinary life to becoming a quadriplegic. Her name is Barbara Turnbull and she was shot in a Mississauga convenience store in a senseless robbery.

programme.title: Exhibit A: If the Shoe Fits
programme.desc: The beaten and frozen dead body of a missing man is found in his abandoned car in Ottawa. The suspects are his wife and/or two male tenants. Detectives unearth stories of jealousy, abuse and a bloody boot. Whoever wore the boot killed the man.

programme.title: Exhibit A: High Park Rapist
programme.desc: Michael Giroux confesses to a sexual assault. A psychological assessment supports his claim that this was a one time offence. While in prison, his house is sold and the new owner finds numerous photo IDs.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Root Cause
programme.desc: The body of a cocktail waitress is found shot and burned beyond recognition. Detectives follow a maze of clues to find the killer. However, the body is so charred, it is impossible to see if the blood in the suspect’s car matches the victims.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Murder in a Small Town
programme.desc: A young female taxi-driver is fatally stabbed and left to die in Banff. The investigators find a knife and blood in the abandoned cab. Hundreds of men are questioned and give blood samples in a cross continent manhunt.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Nine Lives
programme.desc: A woman goes missing in Summerside, PEI. The blood inside her abandoned car tells a terrible story. DNA confirms the blood on a splattered man’s jacket matches that of the missing woman. The jacket is also covered with white cat hairs.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Point Blank
programme.desc: Disguised bandits fell a Brinks guard in Oshawa. The police find a fake bomb in the abandoned getaway car. It is a major forensic clue in tracking the gang. The bandits are charged – but the prosecution needs to find the murder weapon.

programme.title: Exhibit A: The Two Mr. Smiths
programme.desc: Firefighters find two dead bodies on a burning boat in. Another boat has been broken into. The assailants may have drunk beer from the discarded cans on the boat. Whoever broke into the second boat also killed the couple on the burning boat.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Bare Bones
programme.desc: A hunter makes a gruesome discovery near Saskatoon – a human skull. Detectives find the remains of two more bodies close by. A forensic anthropologist determines the three victims are female and aboriginal, all killed in the same time frame.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Dead Drunk
programme.desc: A middle aged Vancouver barber is having remarkably bad luck with his girlfriends – they kept dying. Coincidentally they were all native and alcoholics, so it is some time before an astute pathologist questions the staggeringly high blood alcohol levels.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Blast!
programme.desc: In this special one-hour episode, a labour dispute at the Giant gold mine in Yellowknife has the town divided. After months on strike, tensions reach a boiling point when replacement workers are brought in and union members begin crossing the line.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Orphan
programme.desc: A family is found murdered in their home. They have been sealed up in their suburban house for over a week. The police come upon a ghastly scene. There is no sign of forced entry. Is this a burglary gone terribly awry or something more sinister?

programme.title: Exhibit A: Slaughter of Innocence
programme.desc: A young Asian student is raped and murdered in the apartment she shares with her sister. The killer has left a minute trace of himself in the apartment. His identity is a complete mystery. Who could have killed this innocent girl and why?

programme.title: Exhibit A: Killer Next Door
programme.desc: Two teenage girls are ambushed by a man wielding a baseball bat. He wants to party. The girls resist but, in the struggle, one girl is beaten and left in a coma and the other is raped and murdered, her body dumped in the nearby river.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Big Batch
programme.desc: After the dead body of a beautiful young woman is found in a stream, suspicion falls on a wannabe biker who was seen drinking with the victim the night before. But before police can make an arrest, they discover their prime suspect is destroying evidence.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Deadly Thrills
programme.desc: A gas station attendant is found dead. He has been shot twice and the gas station robbed. With no eyewitnesses, the police have a monumental task before them. The case reaches a dead end, until another shooting reveals a forensic connection.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Night of Rage
programme.desc: On Victoria Day as fireworks are going off, someone is on a killing spree. The next morning, three prostitutes are found dead. One transvestite; one transsexual and the third is a woman. The bullets from each killing prove to come from the same gun.

programme.title: Exhibit A: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: When a young man goes missing and his wallet is found near Algonquin Park, his sister and mother call it murder, but without evidence, the police must deem him a “missing person.” But on the eve of his memorial service, police get a tip about his murder.

programme.title: South Park: Den magiske busk
programme.desc: Cartman og Butters får fat i en drone og tager på en flyvetur rundt i kvarteret.

programme.title: South Park: 'Snuke'
programme.desc: Indbyggerne i South Park lader op til Hillary Clintons ankomst. Cartman har mistanke om, at en ny muslimsk elev er involveret i et muligt terrorangreb.

programme.title: South Park: Medlemsbær
programme.desc: I premiereafsnittet til sæson 20 bliver nationalsangen genopfrisket af et amerikansk ikon.

programme.title: South Park: Sarkastabold
programme.desc: Randy kommer med en sarkastisk bemærkning om, at det er for farligt for børn at spille football. Det er startskuddet til en national sport der involverer bh'er og en ballon.

programme.title: South Park: #REHASH
programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spil med sin lillebror. Men når Ike ikke vil spille med ham mere, er Kyle bange for, at den næste generation forbigår ham.

programme.title: South Park: Feriespecial
programme.desc: Et ubestrideligt bånd knyttes mellem en hvid mand og en indianer.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en anal sondeundersøgelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer, at han har et nærgående møde med et rumvæsen. De andre drenge er overbeviste om, at drømmen var virkelig, og at han har været offer for en anal sondeundersøgelse af et rumvæsen.

programme.title: South Park: Butterballs
programme.desc: Butters bliver mobbet af sin bedstemor, og Stan vil skabe opmærksomhed om problemet ved at indspille en video, men dens succes stiger ham snart til hovedet.

programme.title: South Park: Timmy 2000
programme.desc: Drengene efterligner Timmy, som har ADHD, for st slippe for lektierne.

programme.title: South Park: Fru lærer kysser på en dreng
programme.desc: Cartmann er den nye præfekt og finder ud af, at en lærer har kysset en elev på hans område.
programme.sub-title: Fru lærer kysser på en dreng

programme.title: South Park: VACCINATIONER!!!
programme.desc: Randy fejrer Tegridys succes, og Cartman nægter at blive vaccineret.

programme.title: South Park: Coon
programme.desc: Om dagen er Eric Cartman, en fed dreng i 4. klasse. Om aftenen er han The Coon, en fed selvtægtsmand, der er klædt ud som vaskebjørn og vildt opmærksomhedssøgende.

programme.title: South Park: Den nye Terrance og Phillip-trailer
programme.desc: Alle børnene i South Park er superspændte på at se den første trailer for den nye Terrance og Phillip-film.

programme.title: South Park: Glutenfri ebola
programme.desc: South Park bliver glutenfrit.

programme.title: South Park: Julesne
programme.desc: Julemanden stjæler al byens juleglæde.

programme.title: South Park: Usikkerhed
programme.desc: Cartman anskaffer sig et nyt sikringssystem til hjemmet.

programme.title: South Park: Dumme forkælede luder-video-legetøj
programme.desc: Paris Hilton åbner en butik i South Park og fordærver moralen blandt byens piger. Kun Wendy holder fast i den gamle moral.

programme.title: South Park: Hot katolsk kærlighed
programme.desc: Præst Maxi rejser til Rom, da skandalen i den katolske kirke truer med at påvirke antallet af kirkegængere i South Park negativt.

programme.title: South Park: Stanleys Cup
programme.desc: Stan bliver træner for Pee Wee Hockey-holdet og prøver at gøre dem til et vinderhold.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny biver fanget af den nyeste dille fra Japan, Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Pragtsvinet og Bæ
programme.desc: Da PETA ødelægger South Parks maskot, splitter diskussionen om en erstatning skolen. Stan trues af P Diddy og bortvises fra byen for at at nægte at stemme.

programme.title: South Park: Help, My Teenager Hates Me!
programme.desc: Drengene finder ud af, at med glæden ved at spille Airsoft, følger udfordringen at skulle forholde sig til teenagere.

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporno
programme.desc: Drengene bruger spillet Minecraft til at forhindre sine forældre I at skade hinanden.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 1
programme.desc: Drengene befinder sig i et magisk land, hvor hele verdens fantasi ligger lige foran dem. Men en terrorplan truer med at ødelægge det hele.

programme.title: South Park: Den mexicanske glofrø fra det sydlige Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Som en del af skolearbejdet skal børnene finde ud af Vietnam og tror på en latterlig historie, som Stans onkel Jimbo finder på.
programme.sub-title: Den mexicanske glofrø fra det sydlige Sri Lanka

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer kvarteret
programme.desc: Som det eneste rige barn i byen, føler Token sig som et udskud, og detlykkes ham at tiltrække adskillige andre velhavende folk til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Rødtotter
programme.desc: Cartman lider af et tilfælde af 'Gingervitus' og tager kampen op mod forfølgelsen af hans rødhårede fæller.

programme.title: South Park: Goth Kids 3: Posørernes dag
programme.desc: Goth-ungerne sendes på en lejr for problembørn.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle bliver uvenner over en magisk trekant, som dukker op på en arkæologisk udgravning. Trekanten giver magt til at forandre Barbra Streisand til et forfærdeligt monster.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 3
programme.desc: Stan og Butters er strandet i Imaginationland og må kæmpe for livet mod en hær af onde kræfter. Kyle og Cartman er stadig i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: En million små fibre
programme.desc: Towelie skriver en bog, og den bliver udvalgt til Oprahs bogklub. Den bliver en bestseller for folk, som prøver at bekæmpe deres afhængighed.

programme.title: South Park: Døde kendisser
programme.desc: Michael Jacksons spøgelse nægter at acceptere sin hedengang og efterlader resten af de nylig afdøde berømtheder frustrerede i Skærsilden.

programme.title: South Park: Krøblingekamp!
programme.desc: Big Gay Al vender tilbage til South Park men bliver kasseret som spejderfører, fordi han er bøsse.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantændelse
programme.desc: Indbyggerne i South Park eksploderer tilfældigt. Stans far er et af tilfældene.

programme.title: South Park: Chef vender tilbage
programme.desc: Byen er begejstret, da Chef vender hjem efter at have rejst rundt i verden med 'The Super Adventure Club.'

programme.title: South Park: Faith Hilling
programme.desc: Den seneste meme-mode i byen er 'Faith Hilling', men trenden går af mode da Faith Hilling afbryder republikanernes præsidentdebat.

programme.title: South Park: Gnomer (underbukse-gnomer)
programme.desc: Drengene skal skrive en opgave til skolen. Tweek foreslår, at de skriver om gnomer, der besøger ham hver nat og stjæler hans underbukser.
